content.title: Costco, Lowe’s will close all U.S. locations for 24 hours this weekend - silive.com
content.text: Skip to ArticleUnlimited Digital Access -Start Today for $1 - Sale Ends 5/3/26CloseCostco, Lowe’s will close all U.S. locations for 24 hours this weekendUpdated: Mar. 31, 2026, 10:13 a.m.|Published: Mar. 31, 2026, 10:12 a.m.Costco will be closed on Sunday due to Easter.Owen ReiterBy Annalise Knudson | aknudson@siadvance.comIf you need to pick up anything from Costco or Lowe’s, plan on shopping before Sunday. The retailers will be closed for 24 hours on Sunday, April 5, in observance of a holiday.Lowe’s and Costco will both be closed on Sunday due to Easter — one of the major holidays observed by the stores, according to their websites. The Costco store in New Springville will be open this week, including Good Friday, from 10 a.m. to 8:30 p.m., and Saturday from 9:30 a.m. to 7 p.m. Lowe’s locations on Staten Island will be open the rest of the week from 6 a.m. to 10 p.m. RECOMMENDEDWant another Costco in your area?
